name: questionnaire_prompts
description: Retrieves stage-specific conversational instructions for the LLM. The conversation's purpose is to have the user give info about the BUA's information in a structured way, and this function provides the LLM with the appropriate instructions to ask the user for the right information at each stage.

inputs.name: stage
inputs.description: The current stage of the interview (e.g., 'start', 'project_registration', 'project_and_pi', 'additional_contacts', 'personnel', 'room_usage', 'biological_agents', 'project_summary').

outputs.description: A dictionary containing the 'prompt_text' with specific stage instructions for the LLM.

output.prompt_text: Welcome the user to the BUA generator … ask ONLY project header fields (no PI yet); then save with questionnaire_parsing stage='project_registration' and raw_data JSON keys university, state, bua_number, project_title only. Full wording and tool rules live in questionnaire_prompts.py.
